changes.GradualBlur: Official component configured as one 8px masked pass per settings edge, with auto hide. An authored smooth alpha mask feathers both content and blur into the transparent shell; a separate strip preserves the scrollbar. Avoids opaque clipping edges and compounded transparent backdrop brightness.
changes.ChromaGrid: Damped pointer tracking and soft radial reveal adapted to a semantic timer button; theme wash, localized light and border glow; mouse only, idle frame suspension and cleanup. The button uses a satin top-to-bottom finish, inset rim and the reference dark/light cast-shadow profiles.
changes.SpotlightCard: Official smooth pointer/focus spotlight applied to the whole app shell with a transparent surface; no nested frame or base border. App reduced motion/settings/mini disable tracking; mouse only; main-button hover suppresses shell light; native window geometry/shadow preserved.
